name: local-rag-wiki
description: A per-repository, Docker-hosted MCP knowledge service that gives coding agents a governed Markdown wiki with semantic retrieval. The promise — a local RAG wiki that accumulates durable project knowledge across agentic sessions — is real and the implementation is genuinely thoughtful, well beyond a toy. It's essentially long-term memory for agents, scoped to one repo, with guardrails against the wiki becoming a lie.
